**PASS WITH NOTES:** no correctness or security blocker in the five-file diff. Notes concern the C25/dependency-limited local gate, not a requested code change. Review was read-only.

## Identity rendering

`crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog.rs:1361-1408` keeps the existing comparison and closed parsing intact and labels both sides' commit and extension tree explicitly. Valid seat commits retain `+dirty`; a valid `hash:` source is labelled `source hash:`, not commit. An invalid prefix contributes only its byte length; an invalid tree or oversized report is not compared. The daemon commit is `Services::build_commit`, initialized from the compile-time stamp in `crates/daemon/src/lib.rs:78,699` and also used by ping in `crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:904`. Missing daemon commit renders `an unstamped commit`.

The digest regression in `crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog_tests.rs:1870-2041` pins both halves for Copilot and OMP, the unstamped case and hostile-prefix fallback. Parser tests retain the hash, dirty, length and delimiter coverage. No tree identifier is relabelled as a commit.

## Signal guard proof

The changed test waits for the fresh fake-build started marker, asserts one snapshot before signalling, asserts it remains while the build has not been released, then releases the build and requires the numeric signal-specific exit and empty snapshot set.

A dependency-free probe reused this head's committed fixture and exact signal-test body, with Node's TypeScript stripping and `node:assert` replacing only the Vitest assertions. This is supplemental behavior/mutation evidence, not a claim that local Vitest ran.

| Case | Result |
| --- | --- |
| HUP baseline | Passed; exit 129, snapshot retained then removed |
| INT baseline | Passed; exit 130, snapshot retained then removed |
| TERM baseline | Passed; exit 143, snapshot retained then removed |
| Remove only HUP handler | Rejected at the running-snapshot assertion: 0 rather than 1 |
| Background shared-build and `wait $!` | Rejected at the same running-snapshot assertion: 0 rather than 1 |

Mutants affected private copies only. All owned fixture processes and directories were drained and cleaned. No installation, symlink, deployed binary, daemon, foreign process or review-worktree source was changed.

## Security

Independent scoped security review found no vulnerabilities. `pa_watchdog.rs:1414-1452` accepts only closed lowercase ASCII hex, `hash:`, `+dirty` and bounded `+`-joined tree syntax. Seat reports cannot print controls, whitespace or injected delimiters in these identity fields. The daemon stamp is not seat-reported input; malicious same-user build manipulation is outside C33, while its retained safe-rendering guards remain intact.

## Cost and scope

Production change is render-only: no new loop, poll, timer, request, read or process launch; zero added steady-state launches per second and no added per-seat polling. The changed fake build is test-only: at most 600 sleep launches at a nominal 50 ms interval (at most 20/s per active fake build), ending when the test releases it. It is not a daemon launch site. No destructive production behavior or policy changes.

## Review retro

**magicWand:** emit stage-start/finish progress on stderr while retaining the harness gate's one final JSON envelope. A dependency-free reviewer should not have to inspect process or lock-owner state to distinguish an active stage from a shared-target wait. The signal proof already belongs in the existing test, not a new framework.

**difficulties:** C25 prevents local Vitest proof; the shared target serializes concurrent reviewers. The observations and supplemental signal probe are preserved in session artifacts. A redundant targeted Rust command was cancelled while it was only waiting for the lock, because the full harness gate already includes that proof. No other seat's job was touched.
